name: MediBot
tagline: A camera watches for falls, classifies the injury, and a robot arm hands over the right first-aid supplies.
problem: Bystanders panic in emergencies and do not act effectively.
solution: A Raspberry Pi camera builds a voxel map to detect falls, vision AI classifies burns, cuts or sprains, a robotic arm retrieves matching supplies and a voice guides treatment.
demo_moment: Team-described: simulate a burn and the arm presents burn supplies.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “First Overall Hardware Hack” among 176 submissions.
Goes from detection to physical action.

lessons: A robot that hands over the right thing completes the story.
